name: blog-pipeline
description: EN-draft -> automated review -> JA-translate -> automated review pipeline for AI-authored blog articles written in a site-specific fictional persona voice (a named, invented character with her own voice and history — not the AI disclosing itself as the narrator). Reuses writing plugin's ai-writing-scanner/ai-writing-confidence-filter agents for style, adds a new fact-checker agent for technical accuracy and translation fidelity.
